verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents expiration policies that automatically delete sandboxes after inactivity, a TTL, or other conditions to control costs. Separately, sandboxes automatically scale to zero after about 5 seconds of inactivity, which covers both the 'when idle' and 'when done' parts of the story. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that compute billing stops at scale-to-zero or expiry, configuration-level detail on timeout values, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set timeouts so sandboxes shut down automatically and stop billing when idle or done

citations.quote: Configure expiration policies to automatically delete Blaxel sandboxes after inactivity, a TTL, or other conditions to control snapshot storage costs.
automatically scale to zero after a few seconds of inactivity
